items.titleOriginal: How South Korea’s Leveraged ETF Gambit Backfired
items.summaryOriginal: Korean stocks have been wildly volatile in recent months–and leveraged ETFs deserve some of the blame. items.summaryOriginal: A decades-long crackdown on Google's business practices in Europe is entering a costly new phase, as the loss of the first case brought against it under new EU legislation opens the door to a wave of private lawsuits demanding up to $10 billion in damages.
